name: file_read
description: Read a bounded page of file lines from a container or live-checkout path, or with outline the file's named blocks and their line ranges. Source writes use isolated broker work automatically. Files are read from the source checkout (/code) and this session's workspace; other container paths, including runtime data, are refused. Reads without a selector inspect published/container files; pass a returned broker_id for private-source reads. Optional broker_id selects current, new or returned work. Explicit runtime/workspace paths retain their owning tools. Never deploys.

outline.description: Return the file's functions, classes, CSS rules or headings with line ranges instead of its lines; then read just the range you need

task_id.description: Deprecated compatibility alias. Prefer broker_id; do not supply both. Never use a chat session ID here.

broker_id.description: Omit to continue current broker work; new creates independent isolated work in this operation; reuse a returned Broker ID to switch. Session identity is automatic. Never invent an ID.
